metadata.case_name: WONG CHOI FUNG v. FUNG KAI PUBLIC SCHOOL OPERATING AS FUNG KAI CARE AND ATTENTION HOME FOR THE ELDERLY

plaintiff.occupation_before: general workman working at the Fung Kai Care and Attention Home for the Elderly

source: The first accident occurred on 20 June 2001 when the plaintiff was lifting a tray of dishes from a trolley at her work place she sprained her back.
The second accident took place on 18 April 2002 when she was attempting to lift a big pot of food during her work and sprained her back again.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: prolapsed L4/5 and L5/S1 disc causing irritation to L5 and S1 nerve root
source: the plaintiff suffered from prolapsed L4/5 and L5/S1 disc after the first accident in June 2001 but responded well with conservative treatments and could resume her work on 14 January 2002.
Dr Wong concluded that the plaintiff was and has been suffering from prolapsed L4/5 and L5/S1 disc causing irritation to L5 and S1 nerve root.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: grossly disabled by her back pain
could not walk normally, perform tiptoes and feet walking, single leg standing and squatting
could not sit for more than 15 minutes
definite localized tenderness over L4/5 and L5/S1 level
tenderness and muscle spasm over left paraspinal muscle
decreased range of movement of lumbar spine
nerve stretching test was positive over the left side in both prone and sitting position
mild atrophy of both the left calf and thigh muscle
knee jerks and ankle jerks were present
decreased power and sensation at the whole left leg
deeply depressed psychologically after the second accident

treatments_received: conservative treatments provided by government hospital
steroid injections aimed to decrease local nerve root inflammation (August 2002 and March 2003)
treatments_future: spine operation including posterior decompression and disectomy at L4/5 and L5/S1 levels (recommended; plaintiff declined but was advised to reconsider)

losses.description: Could not walk normally, perform tiptoes and feet walking, single leg standing and squatting; could not sit for more than 15 minutes

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Claim for loss of gratuitous service under Section 20C(4) of the Law Amendment and Reform (Consolidation) Ordinance, Cap.23 (claim discussed by parties)
Deeply depressed psychologically after the second accident
